description: s3pgstore observability dashboard. Covers public-method timing, write volumes, S3 ops + transient-error ratio, target saturation, fan-out shape, sequencer & feed lag, catalog/locking, and GC. Each panel filters to the selected cluster/stage/namespace/bucket/prefix; quantile panels show P50+P95+P99, size+count histograms additionally show P100. The iter-pipeline saturation panels (body-slot wait, byte-budget wait, decode duration, stall counter) are reserved for the vendored chan-based pipeline (Phase 12.x); v2.0 ships a serial pipeline so those instruments do not yet emit.

panels.description: Per-method duration percentiles. Method labels include Write, WriteWithKey, Read, ReadIter, ReadPartitionIter, ReadRangeIter, ReadPartitionRangeIter, ReadEntriesIter, ReadPartitionEntriesIter, Poll, PollRecords, OffsetAt, LookupByToken, LockPartition, MaterializedView.Lookup. Min step 1m matches workload granularity.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, method) (rate(s3pgstore_method_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method) (rate(s3pgstore_method_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, method) (rate(s3pgstore_method_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Method duration (P50/P95/P99)

panels.description: Method call rate by outcome. A non-zero rate of outcome="error" indicates failures the application should investigate; outcome="canceled" usually reflects caller-side ctx cancellation rather than library failure.

targets.expr: sum by (method, outcome) (rate(s3pgstore_method_calls_total{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Method call rate by outcome

panels.description: Method calls currently in flight. Real-time gauge — does not depend on rate-window estimation. Sustained climbs without a corresponding call-rate spike indicate the method is blocking longer than usual.

targets.expr: sum by (method) (s3pgstore_method_in_flight{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"})

panels.title: Method in-flight

panels.description: Compressed parquet bytes per Write/WriteWithKey call. P100 is the load-bearing signal for EncodeBufPoolMaxBytes tuning — a sustained P100 above the cap means the encode buffer pool is dropping oversized buffers (see s3pgstore.write.encode_buf_dropped panel). Bucket boundaries include 8/32/64 MiB to resolve typical workload-tail sizing decisions.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(s3pgstore_write_bytes_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(s3pgstore_write_bytes_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(s3pgstore_write_bytes_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(1.0, sum by (le) (rate(s3pgstore_write_bytes_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Bytes per write (P50/P95/P99/P100)

panels.description: Records per Write/WriteWithKey call (total across all partitions for a multi-partition Write).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(s3pgstore_write_records_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(s3pgstore_write_records_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(s3pgstore_write_records_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(1.0, sum by (le) (rate(s3pgstore_write_records_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Records per write (P50/P95/P99/P100)

panels.description: Encode buffers dropped after exceeding EncodeBufPoolMaxBytes. Incident counter — non-zero rate means the cap is undersized for the workload (oversized buffers are discarded instead of pooled, defeating the encoder's amortisation). Pair with the bytes/write P100 panel above to size the cap.

targets.expr: sum (rate(s3pgstore_write_encode_buf_dropped_total{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Encode buffer dropped rate (incident — undersized cap)

panels.description: Token-race re-lookups: a concurrent writer hit the (partition_key, idempotency_token) partial UNIQUE first, our INSERT bounced, and we re-fetched their canonical row. Sustained high rate = workload bug (shared token across producers) or bad token-derivation logic.

targets.expr: sum (rate(s3pgstore_write_token_race_retry_count_total{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Token-race retry rate (incident — workload contention)

panels.description: OCC version-conflict rate. Spikes indicate WithExpectedVersion writes are colliding — review write fan-in or partition strategy.

targets.expr: sum (rate(s3pgstore_occ_version_conflict_count_total{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: OCC version-conflict rate (incident)

panels.description: S3 wrapper call rate by op + outcome. The library's view: one increment per logical op (acquire + retry + release). For wire-level retry diagnostics enable AWS SDK middleware metrics (see README § Observability — they cover every retry separately).

targets.expr: sum by (s3pgstore_operation, outcome) (rate(s3pgstore_s3_request_count_total{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: S3 op call rate

panels.description: Total failed S3 attempts per op × error.type, retried OR terminal. One series per (op, error.type) pair. Single counter — no need to sum two metrics. error.type=slowdown means S3 is throttling (HTTP 429 OR 503-with-SlowDown API code); error.type=server is a real outage; error.type=transport is a network-level failure (DNS / TCP / TLS / connection reset); error.type=client is a 4xx other than 404; error.type=not_found is a 404 NoSuchKey. To see only terminal (budget-exhausted) failures, filter terminal="true".

targets.expr: sum by (s3pgstore_operation, error_type) (rate(s3pgstore_s3_attempt_error_count_total{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: S3 attempt-error rate (op × error.type)

panels.description: S3 wrapper duration percentiles per op (acquire + retry + release).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, s3pgstore_operation) (rate(s3pgstore_s3_request_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, s3pgstore_operation) (rate(s3pgstore_s3_request_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, s3pgstore_operation) (rate(s3pgstore_s3_request_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: S3 op duration (P50/P95/P99)

panels.description: Wire-bytes per S3 PUT (compressed body) / GET (per-file fetch size). PUT samples sit alongside the uncompressed write.bytes metric; GET samples reflect per-file fetch size for capacity planning.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, s3pgstore_operation) (rate(s3pgstore_s3_body_size_bytes_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, s3pgstore_operation) (rate(s3pgstore_s3_body_size_bytes_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, s3pgstore_operation) (rate(s3pgstore_s3_body_size_bytes_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: S3 body size (P50/P95/P99)

panels.description: Wallclock spent in the client-side rate limiter (Config.S3MaxRequestsPerSecond) before the SDK ran the op. Measured *outside* s3.request.duration — so SDK-side latency stays clean and self-throttle saturation surfaces here. Sub-millisecond is normal when the configured rate has headroom; rising p99 means the per-second cap is now the bottleneck (raise it, or accept the cap and ensure callers throttle their fan-out). Empty when S3MaxRequestsPerSecond is unset.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, s3pgstore_operation) (rate(s3pgstore_s3_ratelimit_wait_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, s3pgstore_operation) (rate(s3pgstore_s3_ratelimit_wait_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, s3pgstore_operation) (rate(s3pgstore_s3_ratelimit_wait_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: S3 rate-limiter wait (P50/P95/P99)

panels.description: Wallclock the SDK's adaptive-mode token bucket held each attempt before letting it proceed. The only direct signal that the SDK is actively throttling: sub-microsecond in steady state, rising into the millisecond+ range once the bucket has shrunk in response to recent SlowDown errors. Pair with s3.attempt.error.count{error_type="slowdown"} to confirm — non-zero slowdown rate followed by rising adaptive-retry wait = the SDK has measured the backend's ceiling and is keeping requests under it. Always fires (no opt-in knob); recorded around RetryerV2.GetAttemptToken inside s3.request.duration.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, s3pgstore_operation) (rate(s3pgstore_s3_adaptive_retry_wait_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, s3pgstore_operation) (rate(s3pgstore_s3_adaptive_retry_wait_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, s3pgstore_operation) (rate(s3pgstore_s3_adaptive_retry_wait_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: S3 adaptive-retry wait (P50/P95/P99)

panels.description: Current open TCP sockets to S3 (active + idle in pool). Up-down counter driven by the wrapped Dialer (+1 per dial) and wrapped Conn.Close (-1). Direct saturation signal vs Config.S3MaxOpenConnections — when this gauge sits at the cap during steady-state load, raise the cap (or accept it and ensure callers throttle their fan-out). Drift upward without proportional load = a Conn leak. Only emitted on operator binaries that use BuildS3Client (s3pgstore-{gc,rebuild}); library callers wrapping their own *s3.Client retain their own transport.

targets.expr: sum(s3pgstore_s3_tcp_connections{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"})

panels.title: S3 open TCP connections

panels.description: Idle-pool hit rate — share of HTTP requests that grabbed a connection from the idle pool vs. dialed fresh. Sourced from httptrace.GotConn.Reused. High (>0.95) under steady load = pool sized well + churn-free. Low = either MaxIdleConns starves the pool, or workload bursts faster than IdleConnTimeout. New-dial rate (1 - hit rate) tracks one-for-one with the s3.tcp.connections gauge climbing.

targets.expr: sum(rate(s3pgstore_s3_connection_reuse_count_total{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix", reused="true"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(rate(s3pgstore_s3_connection_reuse_count_total{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: S3 connection reuse rate (idle-pool hit rate)

panels.description: Partitions per multi-partition Write call. Capacity planning — are users hitting the library with 10 partitions per call or 1000?

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, method) (rate(s3pgstore_fanout_partitions_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method) (rate(s3pgstore_fanout_partitions_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, method) (rate(s3pgstore_fanout_partitions_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(1.0, sum by (le, method) (rate(s3pgstore_fanout_partitions_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Fanout partitions per call (P50/P95/P99/P100)

panels.description: Items dispatched per fan-out call: Write = partitions, PollRecords = entries.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method) (rate(s3pgstore_fanout_items_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, method) (rate(s3pgstore_fanout_items_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(1.0, sum by (le, method) (rate(s3pgstore_fanout_items_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Fanout items per call (P95/P99/P100)

panels.description: End-to-end stream lag: now() − latest feed_seq_at. Sustained non-zero = sequencer not keeping up with write rate. Headline metric for stream consumers.

targets.expr: max (s3pgstore_poll_lag_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"})

panels.title: Poll lag (now − latest feed_seq_at)

panels.description: Sequencer pending backlog: count of files with feed_seq IS NULL waiting for assignment. Sustained growth = sequencer falling behind. Reported by the sequencer process.

targets.expr: max (s3pgstore_sequencer_unsequenced{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"})

panels.title: Sequencer unsequenced backlog

panels.description: Sequencer assignment rate. Heartbeat: a flat-zero rate under sustained writes means the sequencer is alive but not making progress — investigate immediately.

targets.expr: sum (rate(s3pgstore_sequencer_assigned_count_total{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Sequencer assignment rate (heartbeat)

panels.description: Time spent acquiring the sequencer's pg_advisory_xact_lock before the assignment statement runs. Non-zero P95 = a duplicate sequencer is racing or another tx holds the same key.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(s3pgstore_sequencer_lock_wait_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(s3pgstore_sequencer_lock_wait_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(s3pgstore_sequencer_lock_wait_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Sequencer lock wait (P50/P95/P99)

panels.description: LookupByToken outcome breakdown: hit = caller's idempotency token already had a canonical row; miss = new write. The hit-rate baseline tells you whether your idempotency tokens are doing useful dedup work.

targets.expr: sum by (result) (rate(s3pgstore_lookup_by_token_count_total{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: LookupByToken outcomes

panels.description: Current count of s3pgstore_pending_writes rows. Sustained growth = orphan creation outpacing GC reclaim — write-side bug or stuck GC. Pair with the gc.reclaimed counter (next row).

targets.expr: max (s3pgstore_pending_writes_depth{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"})

panels.title: Pending writes (orphan backlog)

panels.description: Orphan rows reclaimed by the gc binary across every RunOnce call (S3 DELETE + catalog DELETE pair). Flat at zero with sustained pending_writes.depth growth = GC is not making progress.

targets.expr: sum (rate(s3pgstore_gc_reclaimed_count_total{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: GC reclaim rate
Iter pipeline (ReadIter / ReadPartitionIter / ReadRangeIter / ReadPartitionRangeIter / ReadEntriesIter / ReadPartitionEntriesIter)

panels.description: Time downloaders spent blocked acquiring a body-slot in the iter pipeline (recorded only when a wait actually occurred AND the acquire eventually succeeded). Sustained non-zero P95 = the consumer's per-record yield work is the bottleneck — bump WithReadAheadPartitions, raise Config.S3MaxConcurrentOpsPerMethod, or move heavy yield-side processing off the iter goroutine.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(s3pgstore_read_iter_body_slot_wait_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(s3pgstore_read_iter_body_slot_wait_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(s3pgstore_read_iter_body_slot_wait_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Iter body-slot wait duration (P50/P95/P99)

panels.description: Times the iter pipeline's body-slot pool was full and a downloader had to wait. Pair with the wait-duration panel — high rate + non-zero P95 latency confirms saturation is real.

targets.expr: sum (rate(s3pgstore_read_iter_body_slot_exhausted_total{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Iter body-slot exhausted rate

panels.description: Time the decoder spent blocked reserving uncompressed bytes against WithReadAheadBytes (recorded only when a wait actually occurred AND the reservation succeeded). Non-zero P95 = the byte cap is binding before partition cap; either the workload is skewed-large or the cap is undersized.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(s3pgstore_read_iter_byte_budget_wait_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(s3pgstore_read_iter_byte_budget_wait_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(s3pgstore_read_iter_byte_budget_wait_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Iter byte-budget wait duration (P50/P95/P99)

panels.description: Times the iter pipeline's byte budget was full and the decoder had to wait. WithReadAheadBytes is binding — bump it or raise WithReadAheadPartitions.

targets.expr: sum (rate(s3pgstore_read_iter_byte_budget_exhausted_total{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Iter byte-budget exhausted rate

panels.description: Wall-clock parquet decode time per partition (excludes byte-budget wait and download time). Flat ~ms = healthy; tail growth indicates large partitions or CPU-bound decode contention.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(s3pgstore_read_iter_partition_decode_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(s3pgstore_read_iter_partition_decode_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", stage=~"$stage", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", s3pgstore_bucket=~"$bucket", s3pgstore_prefix=~"$prefix"}[$__rate_interval])))
